paragraphs.text: First the mark and the frame. In brief, Ruler: hear my pain-joy-mark. Joy is this: meeting You. Pain is this: parted from the Master. Even the subtlest inward spell when You do not appear — the Thee-unshowing spell inside even — her too, Ruler, wipe from all sides, and show Your own stainless shape. In Your frame — world-filled, knowing-nectar-sapped, unending — abiding, ever worshiping the Lord: live, die, else — be mine.

Then the works fabric, item by item. Lovers’ pride shining, birth from nectar-telling, thought-seen-touched chain, grounded pair, sense-wine madness, known unknowns, quartered service, unweighed power-fall, shining beholding, palace rest, offered relish.
Then the widening close. All-widening flashing, whirling thing-ring, poison-nectar, prattle ditties, unwilled will, bottomless devouring entered and praised.
